sentence: This project aims to extend understanding of basic metabolic processes and of disorders such as diabetes, obesity and thyroid disease.
This project builds AI-based tools that link noninvasive hearing tests with changes in connections between sensory cells and nerves in the inner ear.
This project aims to develop diagnostic and therapeutic strategies for cancer by combining imaging technologies with genomics, medical physics and data science.
This project studies how faulty control of dopamine neuron activity can lead to psychosis-like behavior in a rodent model of perimenopause.
This project develops a medical devices course that simulates the engineering teams found in industry to build workplace-ready skills.
This project tries to find out how a dendritic cell vaccine strengthens the immune response and leads to long-term antitumor immunity in glioblastoma.
This project uses biplane fluoroscopy to measure how the hindfoot works after surgery for foot deformities in people with cerebral palsy.
This project studies how proteins, vesicles and organelles move along the axons of neurons and why defects in this movement cause neurodegeneration.
This project supports behavioral and social science research that aims to improve HIV treatment and prevention through work with communities.
This project provides genomic methods and bioinformatics support to study viral and host genomes and epigenomes.
This project brings together researchers to understand how alcohol damages cells and tissues, with a focus on alcoholic liver disease.
This project builds sensors that detect the signaling activity of protein kinase A in the intact brains of living animals.
This project develops reactions for refining complex molecules into analogs designed to treat disease.
This project develops high-resolution, low-cost X-ray detectors that give useful images at lower radiation exposure.
This project uses gene editing to develop CRISPR-based treatments that target the wide spectrum of HIV quasispecies.
This project coordinates cancer-focused training and education activities and tracks their impact.
This project collects, processes and shares MRI and amyloid brain scans to support research on Alzheimer's disease.
This project images living bone cells and live animals to see how bone is built and reshaped and how osteoporosis drugs affect this.
This project tries to find and describe mosaic variants in inborn errors of immunity to understand their role in disease.
This project develops a treatment for recurrent non-muscle invasive bladder cancer.
